messages:
jordan_k: FYI: Dedicated capacity update 1 new H100S-80GB pools going live in us-west-2 and eu-central-1 next week. Pilot only; opt-in for customers.
tia_r: Are we changing burst semantics? A customer asked about spiking beyond committed capacity.
jordan_k: Yes 1 were adding burst slots. Key points:
- Orgs with reservations can burst up to 2x for short windows (max 30m continuous, 3h/day cumulative).
- Burst consumes shared spare capacity and is not guaranteed.
- Admins can opt-out of burst on their org settings.

infra-bot: infra:pool-created h100s-usw2a by infra-deploy at 2025-05-05T06:10:00Z
quentin_m: What about reservation UX and CLI commands?
jordan_k: Console flow: Dedicated -> Reserve -> select GPU "H100S-80GB" -> pick AZ -> quantity -> telemetry consent checkbox.
CLI example:
```
redwood dedicated reserve --org beta-team --region us-west-2 --az us-west-2a --gpu H100S-80GB --count 4 --term 1m
```
Provisioning may take 1-2h in pilot zones.

tia_r: Perf/cost notes? Any benchmarks we can share with sales?
jordan_k: Short summary: long-context generative workloads see ~30% lower p95 decode latency vs A100-40GB at similar batch sizes. Unit price higher but cost/token often improves due to throughput. I'll post internal perf docs and a sample billing impact spreadsheet.

infra-bot: alert:capacity-low eu-central-1b at 2025-05-06T01:45:00Z
quentin_m: Who owns customer comms and pilot invites?
jordan_k: Product drafts GA announcement and pilot invite. CS/Sales get pre-brief. Tia will draft the pilot email and FAQ.
tia_r: Will do. I'll include migration steps, canary templates, and how to request quota increases.

jordan_k: SRE/infra: prepare dashboards for p99 latency, queue depth, placement failures. Runbook updated.
quentin_m: Thanks, posting to the pilot channel now.
